Blocks.Text: The Organizational Page Profiles DMA API represents an organizational page profile—a page with a unique URL that members can visit and interact with (such as follow, comment, or view posts). It serves as a wrapper entity for shared fields among all underlying page entities that are generally managed by an organization, but not necessarily the organization itself (such as brands and products).
For more details on organizations (companies, schools, etc.), see Organizational Page Profiles. For more information on products, see Organization Products.
This API currently provides the following methods:

Get an organizational page profile using the OrganizationalPageUrn.
Batch get to retrieve all organizational page profiles for the given set of OrganizationalPageUrns.
Finder pageEntity to retrive the OrganizationalPageProfile record by an URN associated with a page entity.

Rows.Text: Retrieve your organization’s posts, comments, reactions, and other engagement data. Retrieve your organization’s pages and their reporting data (including follower, visitor and content analytics). Restricted to organizations in which the authenticated member has one of the following company page roles. ADMINISTRATOR

CombinedOrganizationProductPage represents the organizational page is a combined company and product page. School represents the organizational page is a school page. Showcase represents the organizational page is a showcase page. Skill represents the organizational page is a skill page. StandardizedProduct represents the organizational page is a product page.

The URL of the organizational page within the LinkedIn application. This field will not be present if the organizational page is inaccessible by the viewer (i.e. a non admin trying to view an inactive product).

The organizational page's logo. This field will not be present if the organizational page is inaccessible by the viewer (i.e. a non admin trying to view an inactive product) or if there is no logo for a particular organizational page.

The organizational page's cover image. This field will not be present if the organizational page is inaccessible by the viewer (i.e. a non admin trying to view an inactive product) or if there is no cover image for a particular organizational page.

Cropped image metadata used for positioning the organizational page cover image. This will only be present if the organizational page doesn't have a cropped cover image vector asset and only has the original size.

The organizational page's unique name used in URLs scoped to their specific underlying entities. This field will not be present if the organizational page is inaccessible by the viewer (i.e. a non admin trying to view an inactive product) or the underlying organizational page entities do not support vanity name functionality.
